tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, table body, chat composer.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: slider tracks, segmented-control well, user chat bubble, off-state icon tile.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Selected segment inside a surface-2 well; hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline on cards, dividers, table rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Card border when a device is on; control outlines (3:1 non-text).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values. AA on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: room names under devices, meta lines. AA on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, placeholders. AA on bg and surface only, never on surface-2 in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent. Platinum in dark, ink-black in light. Toggle on, slider fill, primary button, active icon tile.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on accent.

tokens.name: platinum
tokens.usage: Brand metal, used only in the cover and marketing. In UI use accent.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Brand dark, used only in the cover and marketing.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Text and icons for risky devices (locks) and destructive confirms.

tokens.name: risk-fill
tokens.usage: Confirm button on a risky action. Pair with on-risk.

tokens.name: on-risk
tokens.usage: Text on risk-fill.

tokens.name: risk-soft
tokens.usage: Lock icon tile, unlocked-lock card wash, confirmation card header.

tokens.name: risk-line
tokens.usage: Border of lock cards and confirmation cards. Never used on normal devices.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Online dot, settled, tool call done.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Online and settled badge background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: No result (motion timeout), pending approval, stale data.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warn badge and banner background.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In-progress: motion accepted and settling, tool call running, focus ring.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Settling and running badge background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible outline, offset 2px.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the confirmation sheet on phones.

families.sans: Inter, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title on desktop and tablet. 32/36 on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Room header, login wordmark, admin section titles.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Thermostat setpoint only. One per card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Unlock the front door for 30 seconds.
styles.usage: Chat text, confirmation summary, table cells.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines under names, table secondary text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, tool-call chips, timestamps. Never smaller.
